narrative.overview:
Lekto is built for Slovak and Czech university students studying under exam pressure—phone in one hand on a tram at 23:30 or laptop open at a faculty reading desk (študovňa) in daylight. Alfa Skriptum anchors the product in the tradition of Central European clothbound technical compendia (Alfa Bratislava and SNTL Praha): composed senior-classmate authority that cuts straight to what to study next without sterile all-white SaaS timidity, Duolingo gamification, or warm-cream literary AI clichés.

The system scales ambition strictly by surface mode across Light, Dark, and Auto (prefers-color-scheme). On #welcome (Persuade), a full-bleed Prussian Cloth stage dramatizes Lekto's core truth—turning a missed quiz question into the exact cited sentence in the student's own uploaded notes. On daily study screens (Operate), standard controls and predictable spatial hierarchy let the task lead while Prussian cloth rails/headers, crisp 4px/6px bookbinding geometry, and Cobalt Press actions carry the world. On #reader and #<subject>/review (Read), Schibsted Grotesk owns the frame so a calm 65ch Literata column can be read effortlessly for hours.
keyCharacteristics: Committed Prussian-Cloth shell over calendered blueprint paper: Whole structural zones (#welcome hero stage, desktop navigation rail, #today priority subject band, legal mastheads, and toast notifications) commit to deep Prussian Cloth rather than floating white nav over grey backgrounds.

One signature move ("The Margin Locus & Tear-Proof"): Cited evidence pairs an unboxed Sulfur Highlighter <mark class="hl"> sentence with a compact § str. N locus badge and dashed tear-register rule—zero nested colored boxes, zero one-sided card stripes.

Role-separated Central European typography: Self-hosted variable Schibsted Grotesk (400–800) drives 100% of Persuade and Operate UI, headings, and pure numeric figures, while Prague-born Literata (opsz 7–72, 400–600) appears exclusively inside summary prose (#reader, #review, and the #welcome proof excerpt).

Bookbinding geometry & hairline ledgers: Tight 4px control corners and 6px sheet corners with 1px structural rules replace pillowy SaaS card stacks, SVG progress rings, blur/glassmorphism, and decorative motion.

rules.name: The One-Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Each screen exposes at most one solid Cobalt Press CTA button (on #welcome's Prussian stage, one crisp #fbfdff primary sheet button); secondary actions use ghost, plain, or recessed Prussian rail styling.

rules.name: The Tinted-Surface Rule
rules.body: Never place neutral grey text or low-contrast Cobalt focus rings on Prussian Cloth or semantic washes; use --shell-muted / --on-shell and --focus-shell on Prussian Cloth, and matching semantic hue tokens on status surfaces.

rules.name: The Unboxed-Proof Rule
rules.body: Cited proof uses inline Sulfur <mark class="hl"> and a § locus badge or dashed tear-register divider—never a nested colored box or a one-sided colored border on a rounded card.

rules.name: The Prose-Fence Rule
rules.body: Literata is strictly fenced inside summary reading paragraphs (.md p, .md li, #rBody > p:not(.hint), .rev-excerpt p); it never appears in headings, buttons, navigation, or cards.

rules.name: The Proportional-Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums only to pure numeric/count/percentage/price columns (.countdown b, .sum-pct, .rc-pct, .tbar-top .pct, .count, .score, .result-pct, .up-pct, .limit-pct, .w-plan-price, .plus-price), never to prose sentences or .pdf / str. locus strings where Schibsted Grotesk's tabular period widens punctuation.

rules.name: The Three-Axis Halation Rule
rules.body: Dark mode compensates light-on-dark reading on all three perceptual axes simultaneously: line-height (1.65 → 1.70), body letter-spacing (0 → +0.005em), and Literata variable weight (400 → 430).

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never place uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings; metadata uses plain sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-Workspace Rule
rules.body: Cards, sheets, rows, and buttons inside Operate and Read never carry drop shadows, neon glows, or hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0).

rules.name: The Masked-Lamp Rule
rules.body: Technical drafting grids (24px/120px) appear exclusively on #welcome's .w-stage masked inside the --shell-lamp pool behind #wProof—never behind .w-copy headlines/ledes and never inside Operate navigation or headers.

rules.name: The Purposeful-Motion Rule
rules.body: Transitions use a single exponential ease-out (--ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), 120ms control state, 180ms screen/sheet/verdict). Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, spatial slides and press scales turn off while preserving non-animated state feedback (.toast.on stays opacity: 1, .hl-block retains --mark-wash).

dos: Do commit whole shell zones (#welcome .w-stage, desktop #tabbar, #today .hero-open, legal .band, .toast) to Prussian Cloth (--shell) and keep working sheets crisp (--sheet on --paper).
Do fence Literata strictly inside summary reading paragraphs and keep 100% of UI controls, headings, and metadata in Schibsted Grotesk.
Do pair every source-proof jump with sourceLocus() (§ str. N badge + unboxed Sulfur <mark class="hl">).
Do verify every interactive target at >= 44×44px and keep <meta name="theme-color">, PWA manifest, legal pages, and native Android/iOS chrome synced with the active screen's top surface.
donts: Don't put one-sided colored stripes (border-left: 3px solid ...) on rounded boxes or wrap <mark class="hl"> inside nested colored border cards.
Don't apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to prose sentences, dates with dots (30. 11.), or .pdf / str. locus strings in Schibsted Grotesk.
Don't use neutral grey text or dark Cobalt focus outlines inside Prussian Cloth regions—always use --shell-muted / --on-shell and --focus-shell (#f4e547).
Don't introduce uppercase kickers/eyebrows, SVG progress rings, backdrop-filter: blur(), hard offset shadows, decorative monospace labels, or gamification (streaks, XP, badges).
